summary_en: CHUBU SHIRYO will acquire up to 1,100,000 shares (3.8% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) via ToSTNeT-3 at a fixed price of 2,132 yen per share, with total acquisition cost capped at 2,345.2 million yen. Results will be announced on November 2, 2026.
title_en: Notice of Confirmation of Purchase Price for Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Matching System (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On October 30, 2026, CHUBU SHIRYO announced the fixed purchase price for its treasury stock acquisition via ToSTNeT-3. The company will acquire up to 1,100,000 ordinary shares at a fixed price of 2,132 yen per share, representing 3.8% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock. The total acquisition amount is capped at 2,345.2 million yen. The purchase price was determined based on the closing price on the date of announcement. The company will conduct the acquisition through an off-hours matching transaction, with matched sell orders used to execute the purchase. Actual execution may be partial or not occur depending on market conditions. Results of the acquisition will be publicly announced on November 2, 2026, following the close of trading at 8:45 a.m. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 1,665,805 treasury shares against 28,706,103 outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.
